description: The latest recorded value of every vehicle state field that has no dashboard of its own: tires, doors, windows, closures, climate, OTA, gear guard, and misc vehicle status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT data->'driveMode'->>'value' AS "value" FROM (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(f.name, jsonb_build_object('value', COALESCE(to_jsonb(l.num), to_jsonb(l.value)), 'timeStamp', l.at)) AS data FROM state_fields f JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.field_id) c.field_id, c.num, c.value, c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = (SELECT seq FROM vehicles WHERE id = ${vehicle:sqlstring}) ORDER BY c.field_id, c.at DESC) l ON l.field_id = f.id) s

SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MAX(received_at)))::int AS "value" FROM parallax_latest WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring}

panels.title: Last Parallax Update
panels.description: Time since the app last received any Parallax message (parallax_latest.received_at). A parked, asleep car sends little, so this grows overnight; orange after 1 hour, red after 1 day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MAX(at)))::int AS "value" FROM state_heartbeats WHERE vehicle_seq=(SELECT seq FROM vehicles WHERE id = ${vehicle:sqlstring})

panels.title: Last State Update (any feed)
panels.description: Time since the app last recorded vehicle state (a heartbeat at least every 15 minutes while it is connected). The app no longer records a legacy-websocket time, and an R2 sends only empty values on that feed. Orange after 1 hour, red after 1 day.
